Just 2 minutes into this video and I have to say — don’t fall for this idea that you don’t need an insurance advisor or agent. I work in portfolio management, and I’ve seen far too many cases where people overlook the value a good insurance advisor brings to the table.

An advisor’s job isn’t just about selling a motor, health, or life policy — it’s about being there when it matters most, especially at the time of claims. Trust me, when things go sideways, these YouTubers won’t be there to help you file paperwork, follow up with the insurer, or ensure your claim is processed smoothly. But your advisor will be.

I’m not here to defame anyone or pick sides. But let’s be rational — everyone has a role, and it’s smart to delegate that role to someone who’s experienced and accountable. Content creators do a great job of raising awareness, but their understanding often comes from online research or a few surface-level examples. On the other hand, professionals who live and breathe this space daily bring a depth of insight no video can match.
